{{Conjecture|legends}}
Circa [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Stennes Shifter/Legends|Stennes Shifter]] [[Species/Legends|species]] faced each other in a '''conflict'''. As [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] killed them off, the population of the Stennes Shifters fell precipitously such that, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the species had numbers as small as a few hundred and no more than several million. The conflict also convinced the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] that the Shifters were a threat to be reckoned with.<ref name="SWAJ12">{{JournalCite|12|Shape-shifters}}</ref>
